Name: JP's Utility Machines - Strange Machines
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][size=6][center][b][i][color=#00ff00][u]Strange Machines[/u][/color][/i][/b][/center][/size]

[color=#00ffff][size=5][b]There are some things that still make sense for these machines to produce, but there are others that only in the wildest dreams could be created.[/b][/size][/color]


[list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]A total of 18 machines that imitate their original versions but produce the craziest objects you could think of.[/size][/font]
[/list][size=4]
[/size][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]9 machines that produce Artisan Goods from objects that you would think would make some sense ([b]Normal[/b]), however there are the counterparts of these, 9 machines that use the most unthinkable objects to create their Artisan Goods ([b]Unusual[/b]).[/size][/font]
[/list][size=4]
[/size][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][i]All machines are unlocked in the same way as their original counterparts, some by raising the Farming skill level, others by purchasing them in the stores.[/i] The recipes of all these machines require less resources to build compared to the original machines. Production times are equal to or slightly less than the original machines.[/size][/font]
[/list][size=4]
[/size][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Unusual machines can be the most unbalanced as they can greatly increase the price of an item, bearing in mind that these machines accept items such as Wood or Stones. [color=#ffff00][i]For example, the base value of Honey is 100g, whatever you place as material will simply increase its value, a Stone worth 2g would increase its value to 105g by making Stone Honey, the use of this mechanic is the responsibility of each one.[/i][/color][/size][/font]
[/list]
[color=#ff0000][size=5][i]Not much more to add, have fun making weird combinations, it's only visual but the names are fun.[/i][/size][/color]


[size=4][i]Fun fact: While fixing bugs I discovered that you could create a Wine or any other Artisan Good and put it back into the machine, which created a Wine Wine. This is fixed but it was curious.
[/i][/size]

[b][i][color=#ff7700][size=6]You can make and publish your translations without asking for permission![/size][/color][/i][/b]
